description: This file exports multiple functions that generate email message objects for various user notifications in an e-commerce platform, such as password resets, merchant signups, order confirmations, and newsletters.

methods.name: resetEmail
methods.description: Generates a password reset email message with a link containing host and reset token.

methods.name: confirmResetPasswordEmail
methods.description: Creates an email message indicating that the password has been changed.

methods.name: merchantSignup
methods.description: Creates a merchant registration email with a link to complete signup, including host, reset token, and email.

methods.name: merchantWelcome
methods.description: Generates a welcome email for a merchant with their name.

methods.name: signupEmail
methods.description: Creates a registration confirmation email for a user, personalized with first and last name.

methods.name: newsletterSubscriptionEmail
methods.description: Creates an email confirming newsletter subscription.

methods.name: contactEmail
methods.description: Creates a generic contact message acknowledgment email.

methods.name: merchantApplicationEmail
methods.description: Creates an email acknowledging receipt of a merchant application.

methods.name: merchantDeactivateAccount
methods.description: Creates an email notifying that a merchant account has been disabled.

methods.name: orderConfirmationEmail
methods.description: Creates an order confirmation email including order ID and customer name.
